# floom

> Deploy Python scripts as cloud automations. No Docker, no infra. Get a web UI, REST API, and MCP endpoint in seconds.

floom is the production layer for AI agents. Write a Python script with a `run()` function, and floom gives you a shareable web UI with typed inputs/outputs, a REST API, managed secrets, version history, and scheduling. Deploy from Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-capable agent.

## Protocol

Scripts must have a `run()` function that takes typed parameters and returns a dict:

```python
import os

def run(input_text: str) -> dict:
    # Your logic here
    # Secrets via os.environ["SECRET_NAME"]
    return {"result": "output"}
```

Manifest defines inputs, outputs, secrets, and dependencies:

```json
{
  "name": "Automation Name",
  "description": "One sentence",
  "inputs": [{"name": "input_text", "label": "Input", "type": "textarea", "required": true}],
  "outputs": [{"name": "result", "label": "Result", "type": "text"}],
  "secrets_needed": ["GEMINI_API_KEY"],
  "python_dependencies": ["google-genai"],
  "manifest_version": "1.0"
}
```

Input types: text, textarea, url, file, number, enum, boolean, date.
Output types: text, table, number, html, pdf, image.

## API

Base URL: https://dashboard.floom.dev/api/
Auth: Bearer token via API key from dashboard.floom.dev/settings.

- POST /api/artifacts - Upload code + manifest, returns artifactId
- POST /api/test - Test artifact in sandbox, returns testRunId
- POST /api/deploy - Deploy artifact as live automation
- GET /api/automations - List automations
- GET /api/automations/:id - Get automation detail + code
- POST /api/automations/:id/update - Deploy new version
- POST /api/automations/:id/run - Trigger a run
- POST /api/automations/:id/rollback - Revert version
- POST /api/secrets - Store org secret

## Installation (Claude Code skill)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/floomhq/floom.git ~/.claude/skills/floom-repo && ~/.claude/skills/floom-repo/scripts/setup
```

Then use `/floom` in Claude Code to deploy any Python script.
